classes.end: The API budget at the floor: a call starts at the floor, the call log past its size, no old log
classes.rule: No call starts while the kept budget is under the floor: each call that runs began with `logged` reading more than FLOOR left, or reading nothing. At the floor counts as under it, as `held` counts it.
classes.cause: a pass reads the budget once, as it starts, and goes on calling while its own calls and another pass's take the budget to the floor

drawnFrom.command: statechart from-spec GhBudget.tla --title 'Does the gh budget hold, and does the call log keep each full log?' --expect-broken HeldWhenLow --png
